Subject: Procurement portal onboarding & renewal checklist for BrightMap expansion

Hi Daniel / BrightMap procurement team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — glad to see the BrightMap product and Redwood alignment for Q2. Per our discussion, BrightMap is planning a capacity increase (+50% token throughput) and a 12-month term extension as part of the renewal. To keep the renewal on track we want to get vendor onboarding refreshed in your procurement portal so finance can issue the PO against the new committed capacity.

Attached: Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF) — completed vendor profile and bank details.
Also attached: BrightMap_SOW_v2.docx (draft SOW with capacity and pricing changes) — this has the proposed term change and expansion line items.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the vendor onboarding steps in your portal and the single point of contact for approvals.
- Any additional docs you need (SOC 2 evidence, updated W-9, certs).
- A target date for PO issuance so we can schedule Dedicated capacity ramp (target week of 2027-02-01).

If easiest, I can upload the onboarding packet into your portal and notify the approvers — let me know permission scope.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

On 2027-01-10 09:12, Alex Martinez wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning — glad to see the BrightMap product and Redwood alignment for Q2.

Alex — appreciate the thorough packet. Quick answers from procurement:

1) Vendor portal: please submit the onboarding form to https://app.brightmap.com/procurement/vendor-onboard (you can use the tokenized link in your email). We require: vendor profile, bank ACH details, signed SOW, and a 3-year indemnity checklist (we attached our standard questionnaire).

2) Docs we need from Redwood: updated SOC 2 report (redacted OK), W-9 (US entity), and the completed Procurement_Questionnaire.xlsx we attached.

3) Timing: once the onboarding is submitted and approvals route to our Legal + Finance (standard 3 business days), we can issue a PO the following week. For your ramp target week of 2027-02-01 that should be feasible if we receive the materials by 2027-01-14.

I've attached: Procurement_Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel) and Procurement_Guidelines.pdf (PDF).
